summary: Busy shopping-strip arterial beside the station; bus zones and 2-minute parking.
reasons: Arterial with bus zones, no overnight parking
Cinema and shops lining the kerb
Rail yard and heavy traffic noise

best_section.where: West kerb of Coonan Street opposite the railway, before the cinema block

drivers.seclusion: Shops and cinema directly on the kerb; Nordale Gardens apartments 15 m away at the south end; station and rail yard opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Multi-lane road with a short kerbside lane used for brief stops; bus zones and No Stopping stretches.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial next to Indooroopilly station; constant traffic and trains.
drivers.convention: Signs are 2-minute parking, Bus Zone and No Stopping Any Time, so no overnight stays.

flags: Signed 2-minute parking, bus zones and No Stopping Any Time
Station and shopping area, very exposed
sun_shade: Open to the sky; buildings shade the kerb in the afternoon from the west.
